datasets.name: SPFN TraceParts (8k)
datasets.license_note: SPFN code is MIT; TraceParts-derived dataset redistribution terms are not stated in the repository and require separate review.

datasets.name: SPFN/CPFN TraceParts high resolution
datasets.download_policy: explicit opt-in only; use 8k set first
datasets.license_note: Same TraceParts-derived licensing caveat as the 8k release.

datasets.name: ABCParts preprocessed by HPNet
datasets.download: Google Drive link in HPNet README
datasets.format: HDF5; points, normals, segment labels, type labels and HPNet-added primitive parameters
datasets.download_policy: opt-in; alternatively preprocess the ParSeNet ABCParts release
datasets.license_note: HPNet README does not state a dataset license; preserve ABC/ParSeNet provenance and review terms before redistribution.

datasets.name: ABCParts-Mini100 (ParSeNet train-derived)
datasets.derived_parameter_reference: quality-gated fits from official points/normals; never reported as original CAD GT
datasets.download_policy: no download required; do not fetch the 69 GB HPNet archive
datasets.annotation_status: official ParSeNet train segmentation/type labels; derived parameter references only
datasets.evaluation_note: This is a reproducible train-derived stress benchmark, not an official ABCParts test result. The supplied HDF5 omits train_ids.txt, so stable HDF5 row indices are used as sample IDs.

datasets.name: BA-Primitive Fitting Dataset
datasets.format: 1773 CSV files: 591 shapes x clean/error/error_double; each file has 1000 rows of x,y,z,nx,ny,nz,label
datasets.license_note: No license file was present at the verified commit.
datasets.evaluation_note: Not an instance-segmentation benchmark. Published size sequences give some radius/extent values, but random orientation parameters are not stored; any recovered parameter reference must be labeled derived pseudo-GT.

datasets.name: Cylinders_detection_Cao_V2
datasets.format: two raw PLY pipeline scans (about 24 MB and 27 MB), MATLAB code and MAT/TXT intermediate/detected models
datasets.license_note: No repository-level license was visible; a license file exists only in the adjustment subfolder and must not be assumed to cover all data/code.
datasets.evaluation_note: Detected-cylinder MAT files are algorithm outputs, not independent GT. Quantitative precision/recall requires a separately versioned manual annotation protocol.

datasets.name: Primitive Object Dataset
datasets.format: PCD plus TXT labels; 8000 virtual and 200 Intel RealSense SR300 captures
datasets.label_schema: type, position xyz, quaternion xyzw, dimensions xyz
datasets.download_policy: opt-in from OSF; start with the 200 real PCD files
datasets.license_note: The data note states a CC0 waiver applies to the released data unless otherwise stated.
datasets.evaluation_note: Scenes include table/background and provide no point mask. Parameter recovery can be scored only after a declared color/depth mask policy; do not report point IoU as official GT.
